Registration & Sticker Renewal in Gaithersburg, MD

Register or renew your Maryland vehicle for 1, 2, or 3 year terms at All Wheels Tag & Title, an MVA-authorized agency at 201 N Frederick Ave in Gaithersburg. Skip the MVA line: most visits take about 10 minutes and walk-ins are welcome.

🏷️ Mention our website for $5 off registration renewal (*excludes tag returns)

What to bring

  • ✅ ID (driver's license)
  • ✅ Title or registration card
  • ✅ Proof of insurance
  • ✅ Inspection (new registration)

How it works

  1. Walk in or call us at (240) 669-8558.
  2. Choose a 1, 2, or 3 year term.
  3. We process your registration and stickers while you wait.

Common questions

Moving out of Maryland — what about my plates?

Return the plates to the MVA before canceling your insurance to avoid a compulsory insurance violation.

Need insurance first?

We can help you secure auto insurance through our partner Tram's Insurance.
